stories.title: Russian strikes cut power and water across Kyiv
stories.summary: Russian drone and missile attacks triggered hours-long power and water outages across Kyiv, while the death toll in a bombed village in southern Ukraine rose to 40. Ukraine said Russia launched 310 drones overnight.

stories.title: Democrats take control of US Congress in midterm sweep
stories.summary: Democrats won both the House and Senate in Tuesday's midterms, seizing control of Congress for the rest of Donald Trump's term. The result reflected deep voter anger over living costs, tariffs and the Iran war.

stories.title: Meta draws record €53B in orders for debut euro bond sale
stories.summary: Meta received a record €53 billion in investor orders for its first euro-denominated bond sale as it funds AI infrastructure. The offering follows a $15 billion US-dollar deal and targets AI models and services.

stories.title: Tencent launches Hy4 model with vision and computer use
stories.summary: Tencent released Hy4, a 770-billion-parameter model that adds visual understanding and computer-use skills to its flagship AI. Weights and a system card are set to be released soon.

stories.title: Shedeur Sanders takes first-team reps for Browns
stories.summary: With Deshaun Watson sidelined, coach Todd Monken said Shedeur Sanders will take first-team practice reps. Sanders could make his first start of 2026 in Sunday's game against the Saints.

stories.title: Browns place Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol
stories.summary: Cleveland placed starting QB Deshaun Watson in the NFL's concussion protocol after he reported symptoms following a hit in Sunday's loss to Pittsburgh. His status for the Saints game is unclear.

stories.title: Ohio State and Oregon meet with playoff hopes on the line
stories.summary: No. 12 Ohio State hosts No. 23 Oregon with both teams fighting to stay alive in the College Football Playoff race. Backup QBs Luke Fahey and Dylan Raiola start after injuries to Julian Sayin and Dante Moore.

stories.title: Urban Meyer: 'It's time to panic' after Ohio State's USC loss
stories.summary: Former coach Urban Meyer said the Buckeyes should be alarmed after their second loss of the season, a 30-18 defeat at USC. Ohio State now needs to win out to reach the playoff.

stories.title: Buckeyes sit outside CFP field after first rankings
stories.summary: Ohio State landed at No. 12 in the first College Football Playoff rankings, just outside the 12-team field, after its loss to USC. Ryan Day is regrouping ahead of Saturday's Oregon game.

stories.title: Five things to watch at the F1 São Paulo Grand Prix
stories.summary: Mercedes can clinch the 2026 constructors' title at Interlagos, where it needs to outscore Ferrari to wrap up its ninth championship. Kimi Antonelli returns as F1's youngest-ever world champion.

stories.title: Verstappen wants 'a conversation' with Red Bull engine over braking
stories.summary: Max Verstappen said his Red Bull Ford power unit's engine braking behaves inconsistently and 'randomly.' He wants improvements after complaints in Austin and Mexico.

stories.title: One dead, one injured in Columbus' Milo-Grogan shooting
stories.summary: A shooting in the Milo-Grogan neighborhood left one person dead and another injured. Columbus police responded to the 800 block of Gibbard Avenue on Wednesday morning.

stories.title: Columbus voters approve Issues 8 and 9 to overhaul City Council
stories.summary: Voters passed both charter amendments changing how City Council members are elected, moving to district-only races and adding four at-large seats. Issue 8 passed with about 82% support, Issue 9 with 57%.

stories.title: Amy Acton elected Ohio's first woman governor
stories.summary: Democrat Amy Acton defeated Vivek Ramaswamy to become Ohio's first woman governor and the first Democrat to win the office in 20 years. A blue wave and affordability concerns helped propel her victory.
